title: This breakup text isn't from them.
caption: Sagittarius gets a breakup text from Gemini, backpack already packed for Peru. Except Gemini never sent it. If a message doesn't sound like them, ask before you spiral. Send this to the friend who reads texts in the worst possible tone.
